title: Delayed Effects of Temporary Weight Decay in Muon Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2611.17876v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A temporary optimization intervention can increase validation loss when it ends yet reduce it at the final training budget. We demonstrate this with temporary weight decay in Muon-trained decoder-only Transformers with 162M, 405M, 1.4B, and 3.4B parameters. For models up to 1.4B parameters, moving a fixed-duration decay window from early to late training reverses its final effect. At 162M, changing window duration alters final loss even at approximately matched total shrinkage. Most strikingly, a schedule selected at 162M and transferred without retuning to 1.4B is 0.26 nats worse than no decay when removed, overtakes it only after 73% of training, and ultimately finishes 0.028 nats better while also outperforming the best sampled constant-decay baseline. translated_title: Muon预训练中临时权重衰减的延迟效应
translated_abstract: 一种临时的优化干预在其结束时可能会增加验证损失，但在最终训练预算下却能降低验证损失。我们通过在具有162M、405M、1.4B和3.4B参数的Muon训练的仅解码器Transformer中使用临时权重衰减来证明这一点。对于参数量高达1.4B的模型，将固定时长的衰减窗口从训练早期移动到训练后期会逆转其最终效果。在162M参数规模下，即使在总收缩量大致匹配的情况下，改变窗口持续时间也会改变最终损失。最引人注目的是，在162M规模下选择的调度方案在未经重新调参的情况下迁移到1.4B规模时，在移除时比无衰减差0.26 nats，仅在训练进行到73%之后才超越它，最终以好0.028 nats的成绩收尾，同时还超越了采样得到的最佳常数衰减基线。早期衰减会留下持久的权重范数赤字，这使得干预结束后的相对步长保持较大。一个近似的范数动力学递推关系刻画了这种缓慢收敛的现象。
tldr: 该研究揭示了Muon预训练中临时权重衰减的延迟效应——早期衰减虽在结束时增加验证损失，但通过留下持久的权重范数赤字使相对步长保持较大，最终反而降低最终损失，且小规模模型上选出的衰减调度无需重新调参即可成功迁移到更大规模模型。
en_tdlr: Temporary weight decay in Muon pretraining exhibits delayed effects—early decay initially worsens validation loss but ultimately improves it by leaving a persistent weight-norm deficit that keeps relative steps larger, and decay schedules selected at small scale transfer to larger models without retuning.
